fields.name: balance_side
fields.doc:
The side ("BUY"/"SELL") the current `balance` snapshot was FETCHED for.
DEVICE-FIX (Buy↔Sell reversed / 0 avail, 2026-07-01): the SPOT
max-available endpoint returns a SIDE-DEPENDENT `available`
(BUY → quote-ccy avail e.g. USDT; SELL → base-ccy avail e.g. the coin —
`spot_types.rs:443-445`). After a side flip the retained snapshot
(ROOT #2 keeps it to avoid a `--` flash) belongs to the PRIOR side, so
deriving/rendering it against the NEW `side` shows the other side's value
under the wrong ccy label (reversed) or a stale/0 figure. The avail
projection + the seekbar percent-calc gate their `Loaded` output on
`balance_side == side`; a mismatch renders `--` (Loading) until the
side-change re-fetch stamps the new side here. Every balance write site
sets this to the side it fetched. Empty until the first fetch lands.

fields.name: balance_inst
fields.doc:
The instrument (`inst_id`) the current `balance` snapshot was FETCHED for.
DEVICE-FIX (coin-switch stale avail, 2026-07-06): the max-available
`available` / `max_size` are per-instrument. A coin switch that keeps the
SAME side (`apply_instrument_snapshot` only rewrites `s.inst_id`, never
invalidates the ROOT #2-retained snapshot) leaves `balance_side == side`
TRUE, so the avail projection gate passed the PRIOR coin's snapshot as
`Loaded` → the row kept showing the previous coin's value AND ccy unit.
The projection + seekbar/market-max gates now also require
`balance_inst == inst_id`; a mismatch renders `--` until the inst-change
re-fetch stamps the new instrument here (spot-limit "switch invalidates"
parity). Every balance write site sets this to the inst it fetched.

validate inputs → write `validation_error` on failure (errors via state, not
transient UxEvent — ux-side-effect R2) → route by confirm/pre-check flags:
- dialog OFF: emit `DirectPlaceOrder` then place directly.
- dialog ON + pre-check needed: spawn `PreCheckOrder`; on success emit
`ShowOrderConfirmDialog` (Kotlin then reads `build_confirm_snapshot`).
- dialog ON + no pre-check: emit `ShowOrderConfirmDialog` directly.

listeners-019 Buy/Sell place-order buttons). Blueprint parity:
`spot_limit_interactor.rs:4688 submit_order` + legacy SpotTrigger
`spot_trigger_interactor.rs:637`.

but BOTH canonical siblings (blueprint:4688 + legacy:637) declare
`fn submit_order(&self)` with NO side parameter — side is read from
`state.side`, set earlier by the side-tab action. Per R-MIG-066 the
grep-verified sibling contract wins over the brief's shorthand: adding a
`side` parameter would deviate from both siblings and duplicate state the
interactor already owns. Signature mirrors the siblings.

hit the price limit; confirm placing at the currently allowed price")
instead of toasting. Accepting it adopts the suggested price, **drops the attached

market-execution plan order has no user limit price for the server to correct.

constructor is retained for the test / standalone fallback path only.

session-driven behaviour is the instrument-switch refresh, which mirrors
V1 (`switch_instrument` + `refresh`).

doc:
UI-ready *business data* for the position share poster.

Replaces the price / PnL / name / side derivation that Kotlin
`SharePositionDataMapper` + `ShareUtils.positionToShare`
(`ShareUtils.kt:354-437`) previously reconstructed from a legacy
`TradePositionManager.PositionItem` via `TradeCoreProxy`. Native consumes
this VO and keeps ownership of the poster rendering itself — the poster
image, `PlanetShareUtil.getPositionShareModel` planet JSON, theme/colors,
the `AssetShareBean` (`com.okinc.unify_trade.biz`) shape, and the IM share
params all stay in Kotlin (they are rendering, not business data).

Native-source field map (Kotlin `ShareUtils.positionToShare`):
- `entry_price` ← `SharePositionDataMapper.getFormattedEntryPrice`
(`SharePositionDataMapper.kt:216-247`) via
`CTPositionFormatter::format_share_entry_price`.
- `last_mark_price` ← `SharePositionDataMapper.getFormattedLastMarkPrice`
(`SharePositionDataMapper.kt:295-315`) via
`CTPositionFormatter::format_share_last_mark_price` (last-vs-mark by
`isPnlSelectedLastPrice`).
- `pnl_text` / `pnl_unit` ← `SharePositionDataMapper.getFormattedPnlTextAndUnit`
(`SharePositionDataMapper.kt:147-163`) via
`CTPositionFormatter::format_share_pnl_text_and_unit` (sign + SPOT/MARGIN
margin-margin vs profit `fmtPl`).
- `pnl_ratio` ← `positionItem.getPnlPriceRatio()` (`ShareUtils.kt:397`):
the raw PnL ratio at the selected price-type. Mirrored by
`PositionData::get_pnl_ratio` (OPTION always mark). Carried RAW (not
percent-scaled) because Native binds `AssetShareBean.rate` to the raw
ratio string exactly as `getPnlPriceRatio()` returned it.
- `share_name` ← `getShareName(instId, instType)` (`TradeOrderDataExtension.kt:2149`)
across the 5 product lines: SPOT/MARGIN → `BASE/QUOTE` from coinFormat;
FUTURES/SWAP/OPTION/EVENTS → `TradeTitleUtils.getTitleByIdAndType`. The
`TradeTitleUtils` title is a Native title-formatter read (instrument
display name), so Native keeps the `share_name` derivation; this VO does
NOT duplicate it (see note below).
- `share_business_name` ← `getShareBusinessName(instType, instId)`
(`TradeOrderDataExtension.kt:2123`): static CDKeys per product line (+
FUTURES pre-market empty-string gate). Native owns the CDKey mapping.
- `share_type_side` ← `getShareType(positionItem)` = `getPositionsSide()`
(`ShareUtils.kt:915-917`): the 4-way side `net_buy`/`net_sell`/`long`/
`short`. Mirrored by `PositionData::get_position_side`. Native maps it to
the label CDKey via `getShareTypeString` (`ShareUtils.kt:919-935`) — UI
copy stays Native.
- `is_rise_up` ← `positionItem.isRiseUp(getPositionsSide())`
(`PositionItemEx.kt:292`): `net_buy`/`long` → true else false. Drives the
poster rise/fall color + `isLong`.
- `settle_ccy` ← EVENT settle currency
(`(getSuggestedInstrument(...) as EventInstrument).settleCcy ?: USDT`,
`ShareUtils.kt:415`): only consulted by Native when the position is an
EVENT contract and `pnl_unit` is empty. Empty string for non-EVENT.

Why some fields are intentionally NOT on this VO (left to Native):
- `share_name` (title): a `TradeTitleUtils` display-name read, kept native
so this VO does not couple to title-format business that lives elsewhere.
- The `getShareTypeString` / `getPositionLastMarkPriceText` CDKey labels:
UI copy, mapped by Native from `share_type_side` / `share_uses_last_label`.
- Poster rendering / planet JSON / theme: rendering, not data.

paired with the PREVIOUS one, looking BACKWARDS. The sign is preserved:
an instrument whose `prevFundingTime` is later than its `fundingTime`

doc:
Chase-limit amend fields for a "Chase Limit post-trigger type" plan order.

V1 backend contract (`/api/v5/trade/amend-algos`, pre-trigger only): the amend
request carries ONLY the editable VALUES (`advChaseParams:[{newChaseVal,
newMaxChaseVal}]`); the chase MODE (sub-type / distance-type / unit) and the
max-chase ENABLED flag are IMMUTABLE and are NOT sent. So the mode/unit/enabled
fields below are DISPLAY-ONLY (seeded from the bound order's `advChaseParams`,
mirror of the PLACE trigger interactor's chase state shape) and only the gap
value (`new_chase_val`, editable in gap/distance mode) + the max value
(`new_max_chase_val`, editable only when max-chase enabled) accept edits.

Layout by variant (C8):
- at-BBO (`chase_sub_type == BidAskPrice`, chase_val 0) → entire chase area
display-only; nothing editable.
- gap (`chase_sub_type == BidAskDistance`, chase_val > 0) → gap input editable;
unit shown but fixed.
